annotations.title: What appliance repair actually costs (real job records)

description: What customers actually paid for appliance repair (refrigerator, washer, dryer, dishwasher, oven_range, microwave, ice_maker, or all), as typical price ranges (25th-75th percentile, rounded to $25) from TN Appliance Exchange's own job records in Middle Tennessee and South Louisiana since Sep 2022, plus the diagnostic-fee norm, what drives the price and repair-or-replace numbers (fixed on the first visit, needed a part, not fixable). Answers "how much does it cost to fix a dryer?" or "should I repair or replace my washer?". Numbers with fewer than 5 jobs behind them are left out, never guessed; quote the label and the page link. One shop's records, not a market survey.
